title: Your Next Ride Could Be Electric: India's Big Push for Charging Stations
description: India is rapidly expanding its network of Electric Vehicle (EV) charging stations across the country. This push aims to make it easier for people to switch fr.

faq.q: How much does it cost to charge an EV?
faq.a: The cost varies, but generally ranges from ₹15 to ₹25 per unit (kWh) at public fast-charging stations. Home charging is usually cheaper, matching your domestic electricity tariff.

faq.q: How long does it take to fully charge an EV?
faq.a: It depends on the battery size and the charger type. A small EV battery might take 6-8 hours with a slow AC charger at home, while a larger battery can get 80% charged in 30-60 minutes at a public fast DC charger.

faq.q: Can I charge my EV at home?
faq.a: Yes, most EVs come with a portable charger that plugs into a standard home socket, though it's the slowest option. Many EV owners also install a dedicated AC wall charger at home for faster and more convenient overnight charging.

faq.q: Are there enough charging stations in India?
faq.a: The number is growing rapidly. As of early 2024, India had over 12,000 public EV charging stations, and this number is continuously increasing with government targets and private investments.

Range anxiety is the fear that an electric vehicle has insufficient range to reach its destination or the next charging point, leaving the driver stranded. A robust charging infrastructure helps reduce this fear.
